description: This file provides functions for comparing Protocol Buffer messages for equality, including handling of various field types, extensions, and unrecognized fields.

methods.name: Equal
methods.description: Main function to compare two protocol buffer messages for equality.

methods.name: equalStruct
methods.description: Compares two struct reflect.Values representing protocol buffer messages.

methods.name: equalAny
methods.description: Recursively compares two reflect.Values of various types, including nested messages.

methods.name: equalExtensions
methods.description: Compares two sets of extensions for equality.

methods.name: equalExtMap
methods.description: Compares two maps of extensions for equality.
